name: std::filesystem::path::format
intro: Determines how string representations of pathnames are interpreted by the constructors of std::filesystem::path that accept strings.

sections.title: Constants
sections.text:
Name

 Explanation

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: On POSIX systems, there is no difference between native and generic format.
